basic_details.scholarship_name: University of Maryland College Park (UMD) Computer Science Graduate Assistantship & Dean's Fellowship
basic_details.offering_entity: University of Maryland, College Park (Department of Computer Science & UMIACS - University of Maryland Institute for Advanced Computer Studies)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: University of Maryland Main Campus (College Park, Maryland, USA)
degree_levels: Doctor of Philosophy (PhD in Computer Science)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Restricted to doctoral candidates in Computer Science: Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Cybersecurity & Cryptography, Natural Language Processing, Human-Computer Interaction, Quantum Computing, and Systems.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: 100% of admitted PhD students receive guaranteed full financial support (~75 to 90 doctoral students admitted annually)
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open global competition; Pakistani students typically secure 3 to 6 fully funded seats annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Guaranteed 5-year full doctoral funding package (9-month stipend + summer support + tuition waiver)

nationality_requirements: Open to international and domestic applicants holding a valid passport
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (BS) or Master's degree (MS) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, or closely related STEM field from an HEC-recognized university with high academic standing (minimum cumulative GPA of 3.50 / 4.00; competitive admits typically 3.75+ / 4.00).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum UMD Graduate School GPA requirement is 3.0/4.0; however, Computer Science doctoral admissions are highly competitive with average admitted GPA above 3.80.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Substantial coursework in algorithms, computer systems, discrete structures, programming languages, operating systems, and linear algebra.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Final-year undergraduate or master's students graduating before August matriculation are eligible to apply.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Research publications (CVPR, NeurIPS, ACL, IEEE S&P) or major contributions to open-source software carry the highest weight in admissions decisions.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: TOEFL iBT min 96 (speaking 22, listening 24, reading 26, writing 24) or IELTS Academic min 7.0 (speaking 6.5+). International Teaching Assistants must satisfy Maryland state spoken English standards.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; instruction and research conducted entirely in English.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: None; diversity in computing initiatives actively encouraged.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Top-ranked candidates considered for Dean's Fellowships and UMIACS Research Fellowships providing additional supplemental stipends.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: External fellowship holders receive institutional top-up awards to match or exceed university baseline funding.

tuition_fee.details: Full tuition remission for up to 10 graduate credit hours per semester plus mandatory student fees covered (~USD 36,000 / year value).

admission_application_fee.details: UMD Graduate School non-refundable application fee of USD 75 paid online.

accommodation.details: Funded from monthly stipend; graduate housing near campus (Graduate Hills, Graduate Gardens, or off-campus apartments in College Park/Hyattsville) averages USD 800 to 1,200/month for shared housing.

monthly_stipend.details: Guaranteed annual assistantship stipend of USD 34,000 to USD 39,000 / year (~USD 2,833 to 3,250 / month; ~PKR 793,000 to 910,000 / month) provided via Graduate Research Assistantships (GRA) or Teaching Assistantships (TA).

airfare.details: International flights between Pakistan and Washington Dulles (IAD) / Reagan National (DCA) are self-funded.

visa_fee.details: US F-1 visa application fee (USD 185) and SEVIS I-901 fee (USD 350) paid to US government.

health_insurance.details: State of Maryland Employee Health Benefits plan fully subsidized for graduate assistants, covering medical, prescription, dental, and vision insurance (~USD 3,500 / year value).

food_allowance.details: Living and groceries costs covered comfortably from monthly assistantship paychecks.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Workstations, Brendan Iribe Center AI hardware clusters, and UMIACS high-performance computing clusters provided by department.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Departmental and UMIACS conference travel grants (USD 1,200 to 2,500 per trip) for students presenting papers at leading conferences.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Shuttle-UM campus bus system provides free unlimited transit throughout College Park, Hyattsville, and connections to College Park Metro station.
travel_transit_allowance.amount: Free campus and local shuttle transit

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single leading US public research institution: University of Maryland, College Park (College Park, MD, USA)
participating_institutions: University of Maryland - Department of Computer Science
University of Maryland Institute for Advanced Computer Studies (UMIACS)

university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 15 global computer science program (CSRankings #9, US News CS #17, THE World #55); powerhouse in AI, computer vision, cybersecurity, and quantum computing.
available_majors: PhD in Computer Science: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
PhD in Computer Science: Computer Vision & Multimedia

university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: 4-year BS or MS in CS/STEM with 3.5+ GPA, 3 letters of recommendation, statement of purpose, CV, and TOEFL 96+ or IELTS 7.0+. GRE is optional.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: AI, computer vision, and NLP attract massive applicant volume; systems, cryptography, HCI, and quantum computing present strong opportunities for applicants with matched research expertise.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Familiarize yourself with labs in the Brendan Iribe Center; specify 2-3 faculty research groups in your application and reference their active grant projects.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: UMD Graduate School TerpEngage Application System
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the TerpEngage portal, choose Computer Science (PhD), select up to three faculty research areas, and upload transcripts and essays.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (September - November): Explore faculty research projects at UMD Computer Science and UMIACS.
Step 2 (October - December): Create profile on the UMD TerpEngage graduate portal.
Step 3 (November - December): Upload statement of purpose, CV, transcripts, and register 3 academic references.
Step 4 (By 15 December): Submit application and pay USD 75 fee.
Step 5 (January - February): Faculty review applications and conduct video interviews.
Step 6 (February - March): Official PhD offer letters with 5-year guaranteed funding package released.
Step 7 (By 15 April): Confirm acceptance in the TerpEngage portal.
Step 8 (May - July): Receive Form I-20 and apply for US F-1 visa.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated automatic funding: All admitted CS PhD students receive guaranteed full Graduate Assistantship packages without a separate scholarship application.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Three academic recommendation letters submitted online through the automated referee portal.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Purpose: 1-2 page essay covering research background, academic achievements, technical motivations, and target faculty advisors.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Integrated into statement of purpose; focus on concrete research problems, past experimental results, and future directions.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing publications, open-source repositories, engineering projects, and technical skills.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Virtual technical interviews (30-45 minutes via Zoom) conducted by prospective faculty advisors to evaluate research problem solving and mathematical intuition.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: TOEFL iBT (96+) or IELTS Academic (7.0+). GRE General Test is optional.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Unofficial scans uploaded for review; official transcripts required upon admission offer.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translations required for non-English credentials.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via the UMD TerpEngage portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: PDF scans of official transcripts from all undergraduate and graduate institutions attended.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani applicants submit 4-year BS transcripts; official HEC-attested documents required only upon enrollment.

required_documents_checklist.specification: 1-2 page essay articulating research background, technical achievements, and faculty alignment at UMD.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Specifically name 2-3 UMD CS faculty members whose publications you have studied.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Three confidential recommendation letters from professors or research mentors assessing research potential.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure professors submit from verified institutional email addresses (.edu.pk).

required_documents_checklist.specification: Detailed CV listing publications, preprints, GitHub repositories, and competitive programming achievements.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Clearly link papers, open-source projects, and ICPC/hackathon awards.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official TOEFL iBT (code 5814) or IELTS Academic score report taken within past 2 years.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Aim for TOEFL speaking 24+ or IELTS speaking 7.0+ to satisfy TA spoken English certification.

required_documents_checklist.specification: PDF copies of published conference/journal papers or technical preprints.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Uploading published papers significantly boosts admission chances.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Admissions offered for Fall semester only. Hard deadline is December 15.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 25% (GPA, rigor of mathematics and core CS curriculum)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 40% (published papers, research portfolio, technical originality, code samples)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 5% (internships at research labs or software engineering companies)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (clarity of research vision and articulation of technical goals)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: UMD CS Graduate Admissions Committee and individual faculty lab heads.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-stage holistic review: Admissions committee screens academic thresholds, followed by faculty sub-committees matching candidates with sponsored research grants and assistantship lines.

competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~75 to 90 funded PhD offers accepted annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_global: ~5% to 6% admit rate for PhD in Computer Science
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~4% to 5% among applicants from premier Pakistani universities
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Undergraduate degree in CS/SE from top Pakistani university, 1+ peer-reviewed conference publications, strong programming skills, high TOEFL/IELTS scores.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of NUST, FAST-NUCES, LUMS, GIKI, and UET Lahore.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: United States, China, India, South Korea, Pakistan, Iran, Canada

fake_websites_and_scams: Commercial education recruiters charging large sums claiming guaranteed admission or funding at UMD. Admissions decisions are made exclusively by UMD faculty.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Pay the USD 75 application fee only through the official UMD TerpEngage portal. Never wire money to intermediaries.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: UMD strictly forbids the use of admissions agents. Plagiarized statements of purpose result in immediate disqualification.
hidden_costs_breakdown: US F-1 Visa and SEVIS I-901 fees: USD 535 (~PKR 150,000).
Flight ticket from Pakistan to Washington DC: ~PKR 350,000 to 500,000.
Initial apartment security deposit and living costs: ~USD 1,500 (~PKR 420,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: GRE General Test is mandatory. (FACT: The GRE is completely optional for CS PhD applicants).
CLAIM: Admitted PhD students must pay tuition out of pocket. (FACT: 100% of admitted PhD students receive full tuition remission).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some student forums claim MS students get full funding. At UMD, guaranteed multi-year assistantships are reserved almost exclusively for PhD students.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain cumulative GPA of 3.00 / 4.00 or higher in all graduate coursework with satisfactory research progress.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research and academic enrollment on the College Park campus.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress reviews conducted by the graduate committee and doctoral advisor.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Graduate assistantships require 20 hours per week of research or teaching duties during academic semesters.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None. International graduates qualify for US F-1 OPT with 3-year STEM extension and employer-sponsored permanent residence pathways.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Funding terminates upon withdrawal; past disbursements are not subject to clawback.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Fellowships cannot be transferred to other universities.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing research advisors requires finding another faculty member with grant funding willing to support the student.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Funding is guaranteed for 5 years; extensions into Year 6 are customary with advisor grant support.
